extraction.Name: Mrs. Virgie Hudspeth, formerly Virgie Goings
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold the same very cheap, and not near what it was actually worth
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she could not raise the money to pay the taxes during the time she owned the land, so sold the same
extraction.Occupation/Income: works when she can get employment by the day
extraction.NOTES: She is a widow; mentally competent; in just fair health; had to leave the Government Service on account of ill health; has no land at the present time, no home, and lives with some relatives at the U.S. Indian School at Rapid City, South Dakota; received a payment of $10.00 in the fall of 1928 and no further aid from Government, State or County since her patent in fee was issued; sold land two or three years after getting the patent, does not know exact date; states she was not defrauded of her land but sold it very cheap; received patent by calling at the Agent's Office after hearing patents were ready for delivery | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Pine Ridge Agency" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')

recovery_notes.rationale: Pine Ridge tribe field had 40+ string variants across the corpus. Consolidating to canonical 'Pine Ridge' for clean tabulation while preserving original variant in NOTES for audit.
